scripts.check: bun run prepare:runtime && bun run check:contracts
scripts.native:dev:isolated: bun run prepare:runtime && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.isolated.conf.json --additional-watch-folders ../ui
scripts.release:prepare: bun run prepare:runtime && bun run check:prepared
scripts.native:build:staging:prepared: tauri build --features staging --bundles app,dmg --config src-tauri/tauri.staging.conf.json && WORKTABLE_DESKTOP_EXPECTED_ENVIRONMENT=staging WORKTABLE_DESKTOP_BUNDLE_PATH='src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Worktable Staging.app' bun run scripts/verify-bundle.ts
scripts.native:build: bun run prepare:runtime:fresh && bun run native:build:prepared
scripts.native:build:staging: bun run prepare:runtime:fresh && bun run native:build:staging:prepared
scripts.ci: bun run prepare:runtime:fresh && bun run check:prepared && bun run native:build:prepared && bun run scripts/smoke-bundle.ts
